subject: CF Turnstile v2 escalation — curl_cffi bypass no longer sufficient

findings.symptom: HTTP 403 on both GET /economic-calendar/ warmup AND POST /Service/getCalendarFilteredData
findings.root_cause: Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode escalated investing.com calendar to interactive Turnstile JS challenge. Page returns 'Just a moment...' (CSP nonce-based JS execution required). curl_cffi cannot execute JavaScript.
tested: chrome136 + Sec-Fetch-* navigation headers — warmup intermittently 200 then 403; POST always 403
two-step homepage warmup then calendar page — calendar page returns 403
findings.escalation_needed: FlareSolverr (Docker, undetected-chromedriver) or Playwright-stealth + cf_clearance cookie extraction

recommendation.path: Provision FlareSolverr container (see docs/mainserver-crawl-techniques/cloudflare-managed-bypass.md § escalation). FlareSolverr solves Turnstile and returns cf_clearance cookie that can be used for subsequent curl_cffi requests.
recommendation.alternative: Playwright-stealth with real Chrome fingerprint (~400MB RAM) — significant memory cost.
recommendation.do_not: Do not loop retry with curl_cffi — all Chrome versions and Sec-Fetch variants confirmed blocked.

current_adapter_state: investing_calendar_fetch.py returns status=error gracefully — orchestration envelope marks calendar as failed but does not crash
